# j's Nuclear
## Kovarex
### Starter Kovarex and Fuel Cell ramp-up
- Optimized for fast ramp-up of centrifuges with 50% of U-235 going towards fuel cell production as soon the first centrifuge is filled with 40x U-235
- Note: First Kovarex-generated U-235 will only be returned once ALL centrifuges are fed with one set of inputs!
## Tileable Reactors
- 10 tile x 292 tile footprint, tileable on the long edge
- The horizontal large power poles are chunk-sized (32 tiles) 
- Fuel cells are LogiBot-Supplied
- One standard water Pump can supply max 2 prints of FULL 2x2!
- water supply in the middle via underground pipes
#### Starter 1x2 Reactor
- Provides the smallest possible footprint for a 2x1 reactor design, good to kick-start power production but keeping the future footprint of the setup
#### Minimal 2x2 Nuclear
- Provides the optimal ration of a 2x2 reactor for heat consumption and power generation possible.
#### FULL 2x2 Nuclear
- Provides the maximal possible heat consumption for late game with multiple prints of the 2x2, due to additional neighbor bonuses

# Changelog
## 2026-07-31
- Created dedicated footprint blueprint that only holds the flooring for better map-view based mapping of area requirements
- Frame now includes input water pipes in a tilable way, so it can be connected even before the reactors are built and propagates through
- Added dotted lines for better map view to the floor tiles
- Better organized sulfuric acid production into sub-book 
- Added full chain of nuclear fuel cells production and recycling via hy_speed's 1-2-1 train system, including train and unload station
- Added Add-On to hy_speed's Base 1 for sulfuric acid production, with optional train station.
- Removed extension to kovarex setup 
## 2026-07-04
- Fixed kovarex (wires were messed up, addded more storage, now fuel only starts when the first centrifuge has 40 U-235 is filled in)
- Removed kovarex extension BP since it is currently not extensible
- Replaced hazard concrete with stone bricks, since that tend to be in the network, to avoid robo logistic blinkings
## 2026-06-19
- First release of 2x1, 2x2 single, 2x2 full, kovarex + extension, shopping list
